text: 美股盘初，特斯拉跌5.2%，SpaceX跌5.3%，特朗普媒体科技跌9.6%。Palantir跌5.8%，希捷科技、西部数据、Nebius、闪迪至少跌超3%，英伟达跌1.2%，AMD跌1%，台积电跌0.8%。 Meta涨2.3%，谷歌A涨3.2%，苹果涨3.9%，微软涨4.8%，亚马逊涨7.4%。 纳斯达克金龙中国指数涨3.2%。中概股新东方涨4.8%，阿里巴巴涨4.7%，百度涨3.7%，拼多多涨3.3%，网易涨2.4%，日月光半导体跌3.6% 民主党在美国中期选举中大胜共和党，科技亿万富豪遭受重创。
text_en: In early US trading, Tesla fell 5.2%, SpaceX fell 5.3%, and Trump Media & Technology fell 9.6%. Palantir fell 5.8%, Seagate Technology, Western Digital, Nebius and SanDisk each fell at least 3%, Nvidia fell 1.2%, AMD fell 1%, and TSMC fell 0.8%. Meta rose 2.3%, Alphabet Class A rose 3.2%, Apple rose 3.9%, Microsoft rose 4.8%, and Amazon rose 7.4%. The Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index rose 3.2%. Among Chinese concept stocks, New Oriental rose 4.8%, Alibaba rose 4.7%, Baidu rose 3.7%, Pinduoduo rose 3.3%, and NetEase rose 2.4%, while ASE Technology fell 3.6%. Democrats won a landslide victory over Republicans in the US midterm elections, dealing a heavy blow to tech billionaires.
